reviews.text: the lip liner color does not suite for darker lips and not ling lasting
reviews.zh: 呢支唇線筆嘅色號唔啱深色唇，持久度都唔夠。

reviews.text: Previously I got a beige lip gloss, but on my naturally pink lips it didn't show off. So I got this pencil, and I cannot describe all my feelings. It's really good. The shade is neutral, close to skin color, it lasts long enough and sits on lips perfect. I recommend it with my heart
reviews.zh: 之前買咗一支裸色唇彩，但我本身嘴唇偏粉紅，嗰支顯唔到色。所以我買咗呢支筆，真係無法用言語形容我嘅感受。真係好好。色號係中性，接近自己唇色，夠持久，貼住嘴唇好完美。我真心推薦。

reviews.text: Very nice colour for overlining on pigmented lips. I bought this to slightly colour correct my mauve lips to a slightly pinker colour. It’s close enough that it looks more natural than brighter pinks or darker liners. The application is smooth and non drying.
reviews.zh: 對顯色嘅唇嚟講用嚟畫唇線嘅話，呢個色非常靚。我買佢係想輕微校正我紫紅色嘅唇色，調到稍為粉紅啲。佢夠接近原本唇色，比起鮮粉紅或者更深嘅唇線筆望落自然好多。質地滑順，唔會令嘴唇乾燥。

reviews.text: Got #04 fig breeze. Love the color and very satisfied with the application. The pencil is nice and soft, but not too soft. It pairs well with the Fwee blurry putting pot in color "without". The lip pencil gives it that finished blurry fade effect making it look flawless.
reviews.zh: 買咗 #04 fig breeze。好鍾意呢個色，塗抹方面都好滿意。支筆軟硬度適中，唔會太軟。配搭 Fwee blurry putting pot（色號 "without"）一齊用好夾。呢支唇線筆做到嗰種完成感強嘅暈染漸變效果，望落好無瑕。

reviews.text: i never liked lip liner until i tried this one. first, the shade is absolutely perfect. it is very creamy and smooth. the brush on the other end is also perfect and blends is really nicely. my one and only complaint is that it is not very long lasting but i still love it.
reviews.zh: 我一直都唔鍾意唇線筆，直到試咗呢支。首先，色號真係完美。佢好滑好 creamy。另一端支掃都好完美，推開得好順。唯一嘅缺點就係唔算好持久，但我依然好鍾意。

reviews.text: Its so creamy and blendable that it wipes off fairly easily and doesn’t stick around after eating. I love shade 5 as a subtle contour for both my lips and nose. It personally leans more brown on my skintone rather than the traditional cool grey contour shade. The included brush at the end is effective but I prefer to just use my finger or a slightly fluffier brush to blend.
reviews.zh: 佢太 creamy 又太易推，所以都好容易抹甩，食完嘢都唔留喺度。我好鍾意用 5 號色嚟做唇同鼻嘅淡修容。喺我嘅膚色上，佢望落偏啡多啲，而唔係傳統嘅冷灰修容色。尾端附送嘅掃係有效，但我自己更鍾意用手指或者掃毛鬆少少嘅掃嚟推開。

reviews.text: Easy to use and blend out and the benefit is that it doesn’t dry out the lips much however it also means it rubs off fairly easy and is not very long lasting. I do like this more muted colour as I have darker lips and find a lot of the other colours unnatural and too pale on me. The finger brush on the end is not the best but I appreciate the thoughtful design of having it in-built, more brands should do this.
reviews.zh: 容易用亦容易推開，優點係唔會令嘴唇好乾，但同時亦代表佢好容易磨甩，唔算好持久。我深唇，所以真係鍾意呢種較啞色嘅色調，其他好多色號用喺我上面都顯得好唔自然、太淡。尾端嘅指掃唔算最好用，但我欣賞呢個內置嘅貼心設計，應該有多啲品牌咁做。

reviews.text: extremely pigmented lip pencil, formula is smooth and glides on so well. it's not transfer proof, however. it will come off if you wipe. also if you have dry lips using this pencil will make it prominent so i recommend a lip balm before using. it's super easy to blend as well. this pencil makes shading so easy and it doesn't look unnatural because the color is so light. blending it out with the brush is so easy
reviews.zh: 顯色度極高嘅唇線筆，質地滑順，上色好順。但係就唔係抗轉移嘅，抹到就會甩。仲有如果嘴唇乾燥嘅話，用呢支筆會突顯乾紋，所以建議用之前先搽潤唇膏。佢亦都好容易推開。呢支筆令描繪變得好輕鬆，而且因為色調偏淡，望落唔會唔自然。用掃推開都好輕鬆。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
